metadataSummary.scope: Paired complete stored active cells/attributes, bounded title/cwd/link/shell facts and actual private-window UI controls. Restores the explicitly prepared title/cwd baseline and initial cells; original unprepared null metadata and hidden-control content are not claimed restored. Verified disposable teardown is mandatory. No URL opening, clipboard, pixels, OS taskbar/native notifications, general prompt-part semantics or stock-grade claim.

observations.limitation: Title component only; no independent icon-name observation.

No independent prompt-part boundary readback. Unchanged cells/metadata are not semantic support.
Explicit empty-title request; retained old title is a negative result.
Actual private in-window toast only; focused suppression and lack of inactive positive control are reported explicitly.
